notes.title: SHOVELBOY patch/small update
SHOVELBOY patch #1
notes.content:
Hello,

This is just a small announcement to inform you that a new build of SHOVELBOY has just been uploaded with a bug fix. This bug was preventing the players from moving/dying (freezing) when they lost all their lives on easy mode, forcing a restart of the game. Everything should be working fine now. Thanks for the feedback!

Have fun!
